_doc: The Spine: one of Rivet's Stud Driver's salvos (Project Redmond R3, data/gadgets/stud_driver.json): never carried, laid by the driver (its `count` unused; its `use` is where it may go). A vertical line of six studs; set off by his detonator, it cuts a slot 0.8 m wide and 2 m tall (data/destruction.json `explosives.stud_spine`) through every layer, steel too (a hatch whole). On a wall it runs up from the floor (`salvo.ledgeM` 0): a slot a body walks through. A small blast round it. A bullet into one of its studs destroys it (gadgets/studs.ts); its `sizeM` is its studs' extent. Our own design and numbers.
name: Spine
